title: Marq AI, now open for all brands
summary: Run a free 90-second scan to see where your brand is copied, then file takedowns in one click. From $99/month, billed yearly.
body_markdown:
Today, we’re launching **Marq AI for Growing Brands** : the same AI that protects global brands, starting at $99 a month. With this new release, brand protection isn’t just for big companies anymore.


Plans begin at $99 a month, and it all starts with a free 90-second scan.


For most of MarqVision’s history, our plans were built for global brands with large protection programs: companies that pay whole teams to find and remove counterfeits of their products.


[Start free trial](https://app.marqvision.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=marq_ai_growing_brands&utm_content=launch_blog)


## Find the counterfeits in about 90 seconds


Picture a founder who sells on Amazon and Shopify. Are counterfeits of her products showing up on marketplaces she’s never sold on?


Until now, finding out meant searching them one by one. With Marq AI, she pastes one link: her website, a store or a social profile. No signups or filling out forms, and the scan is free.


About 90 seconds later, the scan comes back with a risk score, eight example findings, and where the counterfeits are by channel, platform and country.


Want the rest? Claim the report with Google or a work email, and the full scan runs in your dashboard.


## Never fill in another report form


Finding the counterfeits was only ever half the work. The other half is the report form. So you set up your brand once: where to monitor, your trademarks, your official images, your business documents and an e-signed authorization so MarqVision can file for you.


From there, Marq AI handles the paperwork. For every counterfeit it finds, it writes the takedown request: the threat type, the reason and the evidence.


Say a counterfeit of that founder’s best seller shows up on Etsy with her photos. The request is already written when she sees it. She clicks “Take Down.”


MarqVision files it and checks whether the listing comes down. Nothing goes out until she says so.


## Starting at $99/month. Move up when you grow.


A growing brand doesn’t need every platform on day one, so you pick and choose the ones you sell on: three on our Base plan, six on Core, twelve on Pro and 50 on Max. One platform is one marketplace or social network, including all of its country sites. Each plan comes with a monthly allowance, from 30 takedown requests and 250 detections on Base to 3,000 takedown requests and 15,000 detections on Max.


**Base** and **Core** cover marketplaces and social platforms like Amazon, Walmart, Etsy, Shopee, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. **Pro** adds protection against lookalike websites and domains. **Max** adds Chinese marketplaces and social apps like Temu, AliExpress and Shein, plus scam ads on the major ad networks.


Marq AI for Growing Brands is available today. Base is $99 a month billed yearly, or $119 billed monthly. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, and you can cancel before it ends and pay nothing.[See pricing](https://www.marqvision.com/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=marq_ai_growing_brands&utm_content=launch_blog)


Stop chasing counterfeits. Get back to building your brand.[Start here](https://app.marqvision.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=marq_ai_growing_brands&utm_content=launch_blog) **.**


Need analysts and IP lawyers on every case, test purchases or litigation? That’s Enterprise: everything in Max, run by our team.[Request a demo](https://www.marqvision.com/request-demo?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=marq_ai_growing_brands&utm_content=launch_blog)


## Questions brands ask


### What do I need for the free scan?


One official link: your website, a store or a social profile. MarqVision uses it only to identify your brand, and you don’t need to sign up to run the scan.


### What do I do, and what does MarqVision do?


You set up your brand once and click “Take Down” on the requests you want sent. Marq AI finds the counterfeits and writes each request. MarqVision files it and checks whether the listing comes down.


### Which platforms do you cover?


Marketplaces and social platforms on every plan, including Amazon, Walmart, Etsy, Shopee, Coupang, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube. You choose which ones to turn on, up to your plan’s limit. Lookalike websites and domains are covered from Pro. Chinese marketplaces and social apps, plus scam ads on the major ad networks, are on Max.


### When should I choose Enterprise instead?


If you want MarqVision’s analysts and IP lawyers on every case, need more than 3,000 takedown requests a month, or need to act on gray-market and unauthorized sellers, test purchases, raids or litigation, Enterprise is the better fit.[Request a demo](https://www.marqvision.com/request-demo?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=marq_ai_growing_brands&utm_content=launch_blog)
